# Comparison of the single substances experiment with the mixture experiment ? {#sec-MIXSpringComp} Because the single substances were tested again during the mixture experiment, the goal here is to compare the observed effects in both experiments and therefore to judge the reproducibility between the experiments. We then need to compare the dose-response curves for EPX & IMD obtained with the experiment UNI and the experiment MIX (Autumn 2024 vs. Spring 2025). ## Data importation ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code}
